map.每个字母编码为 5 位 a/b（A=aaaaa, B=aaaab...）。: Each letter is encoded as 5 a/b symbols (A=aaaaa, B=aaaab...).
map.用 5 位 A/B（或 0/1）序列表示一个字母，本质上是一种编码而非加密。: Represents one letter as a 5-symbol A/B (or 0/1) sequence — essentially an encoding rather than encryption.
map.：5 位共 32 种组合，足以覆盖字母表；A 与 B 可视作二元符号。: : 5 bits give 32 combinations, enough to cover the alphabet; A and B act as two binary symbols.
map.：24 字母版中 I/J 与 U/V 同码；26 字母版为每字母分配独立码。: : in the 24-letter version I/J and U/V share a code; the 26-letter version assigns every letter its own code.
map.：常用两种字体、大小写或粗细承载 A/B，把信息藏进普通文本。: : two typefaces, letter cases, or font weights carry the A/B bits, hiding the message inside ordinary text.
map.：无密钥，一旦识别载体规则即可还原，仅用于隐写演示与教学。: : no key — once the carrier rule is identified the message is recovered. Intended only for steganography demos and teaching.
map.用 A/B 五比特组隐藏信息于看似正常的文本中。: Hide information inside seemingly ordinary text using 5-bit A/B groups.
map.排版隐写练习：把明文的 A/B 序列映射成同一段文字的两种字体（如正常体/斜体）: A typographic steganography exercise: map the plaintext's A/B sequence onto two typefaces (e.g. regular/italic) within a single passage. It reads as an ordinary paragraph, yet the typeface of each letter carries one bit.
map.A 的培根码为 `AAAAA`、B 为 `AAAAB`；可用两种字体把密文藏进一: A encodes to `AAAAA` and B to `AAAAB`; two typefaces can hide the ciphertext inside a passage.
map.培根码如何隐藏？: How does Bacon's cipher hide a message?
map.等两种样式代表 A/B，肉眼难察。: — two styles that represent A/B, hard to notice with the naked eye.
map.24 字母版和 26 字母版有什么区别？: What is the difference between the 24-letter and 26-letter versions?
map.培根原版把 I/J、U/V 各合并为一个符号，共 24 个，正好用 5 位二进制: Bacon's original version merged I/J and U/V into single symbols, giving 24 letters covered exactly by the first 24 of the 32 five-bit combinations. The 26-letter version assigns the two remaining combinations to J and V. Before decrypting, confirm which version the other party used, or I/J and U/V will be restored incorrectly.
